card.name: Inside capitalized brand and heading words
card.fires_on: Partway through words written in ALL CAPS, such as brand names and section headings like DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION. Also fires on a stray number or space before more text.

modes.label: Split capitalized words
modes.description: A middle piece of an all-caps word or brand name, where more letters must follow.

modes.label: Brand names in caps
modes.description: A middle piece of a capitalized new drug brand name.
modes.example: LEQSEL<<VI>> is not approved for use in RA patients

modes.label: Stray number or space
modes.description: A lone number or space just before the next piece of text.

card.writes: It promotes capitalized word endings and linking words such as 'S, ING, AND, ITY and ED, which suggests it expects an all-caps word to continue.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of long words written in capital letters, like brand names and headings, where the word is not finished yet.
